Dr. Gregory Bennett moved to Arvada from Iowa in 2003, took over the practice from Dr. James Jack, and has been here ever since. That is long enough to have treated families across three generations, and long enough that leaving would be noticed.
It is the difference between a dental office in your neighbourhood and a dental office
